scenarios.title: Failed customer charge leaves order unpaid
scenarios.risk: Orders will be marked as paid in the store even when the payment gateway fails or rejects the transaction, leading to order fulfillment without payment.
scenarios.expectedBehaviorOnBase: When chargeCustomer throws an error, execution stops immediately and markOrderPaid is never invoked, leaving the order in its initial status.
scenarios.howChangeMayViolateIt: With Promise.all, both chargeCustomer and markOrderPaid are invoked concurrently, causing markOrderPaid to execute and mutate the order state even when chargeCustomer rejects.

evidence.note: Base code awaits chargeCustomer prior to invoking markOrderPaid.
markOrderPaid is only called on line 14 after chargeCustomer resolves successfully.

assumptions: chargeCustomer is exported from '../src/payments/gateway' and can be mocked with jest.mock.
createOrder initializes the order status to 'pending' in the in-memory repository.
markOrderPaid mutates the stored order status to 'paid' synchronously when invoked.
scenarios.testsWhat: Verifies that when chargeCustomer throws an error during payment processing, execution halts and markOrderPaid is not executed, ensuring the order remains in pending status and is not marked as paid.
